mapping: successive cumulative ideal cycle durations are rounded down; each cycle is difference of rounded cumulative times; this residual must not erase safety-denied cycles
nominal_service_E: 2 vehicle-equivalents at EVERY planned cycle end, whether green start was executed or safely denied; no partial-cycle expected packet at horizon
actual_N: unique new internal-lane IDs from storage within (t,t+1]; all G/y/r crossings; 81.98m internal length exceeds 58.15556m worst one-step advance
C: per-second integration of final rate, only after activation; external hold explicitly has no final command and separate raw actual count
fixed_rate_error_bound: for any window with fixed command r, abs(C-E) < 2*n + 2*r/3600, thus less than or equal to 4.5 vehicle-equivalents using rmax900; includes unfinished/boundary cycles and <1s cumulative period residual; not a claim of actual tracking
variable_command_bound: C-C_applied is exact command latency, separated from C_applied-E. For each completed cycle i, quantization contribution is r_i*(floor(S_i)-floor(S_(i-1))-ideal_C_i)/3600 with sign; bound via sum abs(r_i)*abs(period_error_i)/3600 plus each partial boundary cycle. Do not claim a rate-independent <n bound. Report exact per-window accounting.
command_latency: pending input changes apply at NEXT planned cycle boundary (including a safety-denied cycle); max23s for a change on the integer grid inside a <=24s cycle. Feedback changes never restart green.
phase_logic: G0 -> y1 -> r2 -> r2; native program performs green/yellow/red transitions, red self-loop prevents an unsafe unsolicited restart. Only planned safe cycle start selects its predefined program and phase0.
phase_timing_origin: G3 is an initial short-packet engineering choice to test nominal two-car discharge, not guaranteed startup/headway. y3 retains current B/C network reference, not a source-certified minimum. r>=2 retains current minimum red spacing. No timing reduction or result-based packet replacement is authorized.
safety: native CF/signal/lane-change model unmodified; observe ALL storage and current ingress every step, route-aware receiver+secure gap before cycle start; all remaining storage/ingress normal braking envelope BEFORE any step whose pending event enters red. EVERY positive speed: 1.1+v*1+v^2/(2*b); exactly zero exempt only with native red compliance. Missing/unsafe -> snapshot and stop without another step; do not extend yellow or force red.
yellow: all yellow observations/crossings retained, normal braking monitored, pending yellow-to-red verified against actual remaining state; no yellow duration safety certificate is assumed
motion_state: SUMO1.26 processCommands then begin-of-step TLS events then motion; a getter may show old phase when nextSwitch==t. Predict one native transition, check BEFORE simulationStep, then require post-step actual state equals predicted motion state.

preconditioning_PhaseB.sequence: G open until600; native y[600,603) then r[603,1200), common external hold for all rates
preconditioning_PhaseB.C_E: not executing a metering command; C=E=0 in prefix ledger, N all actual crossings separately retained
preconditioning_PhaseB.limitation: prequeued technical fixture only; supply insufficiency NOT_TESTED; cannot lengthen after results

PhaseC: natural input, activation600, no preload, unchanged protected ALINEA, T1 only; execute only after all fixed-rate qualifications pass including900
sustained_supply: storage has R at EVERY pre-step in whole300s window; if not, NOT_TESTED. Include all windows and any receiver obstruction; do not relabel a supplied fail.
run_gate: safety+phase+unique crossing accounting+all supplied-window service gates; no qualifying supplied windows -> NOT_TESTED, never PASS
STOP: unsafe phase cannot be repaired minimally
formal_or_effect_claims: prohibited; no sweet spot or freeway benefit analysis
